title: Transporting an adjunct through the two scalar changes

source.place: paragraph (1), applying coefficient extension to the positive section class; trace proof paragraph (1), its adjunction

statement: For a ChernCoefficientDiagram x [def-diagonal-uniformizer-chern-transport], a completed local arrow z and completed direct-image arrow c, assume the first completed-realization square with the explicit coefficient-unit arrow [def-diagonal-coefficient-unit-push]. Define x.scalarLocalArrow z by transporting z through completed realization and the two scalar functors with their prescribed unit inverses and shifted-line endpoints. Define ScalarTransportTo by the first three endpoint squares, stopping before finite realization. Then ScalarTransportTo holds for coefficientUnitPush R followed by the direct image of scalarLocalArrow. No finite adjunct calculation is included.

proof.text: Apply scalar_unit_push and mate naturality at each scalar change. Insert and cancel the prescribed unit inverse at P. Compose the two resulting arrow squares with the supplied completed square and identify the nested scalar local arrow.

theorem scalar_adjunct_transport
    (x : ChernCoefficientDiagram l Y B R A N hN hA hY)
    (z : DiagonalTrace.completedUnit l (ProjectiveLine Y) ⟶
      (DiagonalTrace.completedLine l (ProjectiveLine Y))⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧)
    (c : DiagonalTrace.completedUnit l Y ⟶
      x.tq.Rc.R.obj ((DiagonalTrace.completedLine l (ProjectiveLine Y))⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧))
    (first :
      let uP := (x.completedP.F.mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor 0).app _ ≪≫
        (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).mapIso x.completedP.unitIso
      x.completedY.F.mapDerivedCategory.map c ≫
          (x.q_square.derived.iso.hom.app _ ≫
            x.zl.Rq.R.map (x.completedP.shiftedLine l (ProjectiveLine Y))) =
        x.completedY.singleUnit l Y ≫
          (coefficientUnitPush _ Y x.zl.Rq ≫ x.zl.Rq.R.map
            ((uP.inv ≫ x.completedP.F.mapDerivedCategory.map z) ≫
              x.completedP.shiftedLine l (ProjectiveLine Y)))) :
    x.ScalarTransportTo l Y c
      (coefficientUnitPush R Y x.d.Rq ≫ x.d.Rq.R.map (x.scalarLocalArrow l Y z))
